REGENT OF MOROWALI

CENTRAL SULAWESI PROVINCE

REGIONAL REGULATION OF MOROWALI REGENCY NUMBER It YEAR 2022

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM VIOLENCE BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD

REGENT OF MOROWALI,

Considering: a. b. c. d.

In view of: 1. 2. that children and women are creations of Almighty God who constitute important elements of society, and in the future children will become actors in all aspects of social and state life; that Indonesian women have an important role in social activities, development and family life as well as the obligation to care for, protect and raise Indonesian children to grow and develop as the next generation of the nation; that based on the Provisions in Article 17 paragraph (Il) of Law Number 23 of 2074 concerning Regional Government as amended by Law Number 1 of 2022 concerning Financial Relations between the Central Government and Regional Governments, Regions have the right to establish policies for the protection of women and children which constitute mandatory affairs in accordance with their authority; that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Women and Children From Violence.

Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; Law Number 51 of 1999 concerning the Establishment of Buol Regency, Morowali Regency and Banggai Kepulauan Regency (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 1999 Number 179, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 390O) as amended by Law Number 11 of 20OO concerning Amendment to Law Number 51 of L999 concerning the Establishment of Buol Regency, Morowali Regency and Banggai Kepulauan Regency (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2OOO

Number 78, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3966);

3. Law Number 23 of 2O14 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2014 Number 244, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587), as last amended by Law Number 1 of 2O22 concerning Financial Relations Between the Central Government and Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Year 2022 Number 4. Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 6757);

With Mutual Approval

REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF MOROWALI REGENCY and

REGENT OF MOROWALI,

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading: Article I
text:
Pasal I

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini, yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Anak adalah seseorErng yang belum berusia 18 tahun, termasuk anak yang ada dalam kandungan.
2. Perempuan adaiah manusia dewasa berjenis kelamin perempuan dan orang yang oleh hukum diakui sebagai perempuan.
3. Perlindungan adalah segala tindakan pelayanan untuk memenuhi hak-hak, serta menjamin dan melindungi hak-hak korban tindak kekerasan. 4. Perlindungan anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh, berkembang, dan berpartisipasi, secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
5. Perlindungan perempuan adalah upaya yang ditujukan untuk melindungi perempuan dan hak-halmya agar mendapatkan rasa aman dari tindak kekerasan.
6. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau yang mengakibatkan kesengsaraan dan penderitaan baik Iisik, seksual' psikologis termasuk penelantaran, ancalnan tindakan t€rtentu, pemaksaan J atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang tedadi di depan ufiluin a'tau dalam kehidupan pri'oadi.
7. Kekerasan Iisik adalah setiap perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit, cedera, luka atau cacat pada tubuh seseorang, Sugumya kandungan atau pingsan dan/ atau menyebabkan kematian.
8. Kekerasan psikis adalah perbuatan yang mengakibatlan ketakutan. hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak peraya atau penderitaan psikologis berat pada seseorang.
9. Korban tindak kekerasan Jrang selanjutnya disebut korban adalah perseorangan atau kelompok orang yang mengalami penderitaan baik fisik, mental maupun emosional, kerugian ekonomi, atau mengalarni pengabaian, pengurangan atau perampasal hak-hak dasarnya, sebagai akibat pelanggaran hak asasi manusia (HAM), atau tindak pidana serta tindak kekerasan yang dilakukan baik oleh aparat negara atau olch orang perorangan.
10. Unit Pelayanan Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UP/[D PPA adalah unit pelalsana teknis daerah, yang dibentuk pemerintah daerah dalam memberikan layanan bagi perempuan dan anal< yang mengalami kekerasan, diskriminasi, perlindungan khusus dan masalah lainnya. ll.Forum Koordinasi Perlindungan Korban Kekerasan yang selanjutnya disingkat FKPKK adalah forum koordinasi penanganan korban kekerasan perempuan dan anak yang penyelenggaraannya dilakukan secara berjejaring dan ke{a bersama.
12. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Morowali.
13. Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dalam penyelengg€rraan urusan Pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan Daerah.
14. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Pemerintah Kabupaten Morowali. 15. Pemerintahan Daerah adalah penyelenggaran urusan pemerintahan oleh Pemerintah dan DPRD menurut asas otonomi dan tugas pembantuan dengan prinsip otonomi seluas-luasnya dalam sistem dan prinsip Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Undang Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945.
16. Bupati adalah Bupati Morowali.
17. Dinas Pemberdayaan Masyarakat Desa, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat Dinas PMDP3A adalah perangkat daerah Kabupaten Morowali yang melaksanakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang perempuan dan anak.
translated_text:
Article I

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 years, including a child in the womb.
2. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
3. Protection is all service actions to fulfill rights, as well as guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence. 4. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, as well as receive protection from violence and discrimination.
5. Protection of women is an effort aimed at protecting women and their rights in order to obtain a sense of security from violence.
6. Violence is any act that results in or causes suffering and pain whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threat of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in public or in private life.
7. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
8. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness or severe psychological suffering to a person.
9. Victim of violence, hereinafter referred to as victim, is an individual or group of people who experience physical, mental or emotional suffering, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights (HAM) violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or by individuals.
10. Regional Technical Service Unit for the Protection of Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as UP/[D PPA, is a regional technical implementing unit, established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems. ll.Coordination Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence, hereinafter abbreviated as FKPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked and cooperative manner.
12. Region is Morowali Regency.
13. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent in the implementation of Government affairs which are the authority of the Region.
14. Regional Government is the Government of Morowali Regency. 15. Regional Governance is the administration of government affairs by the Government and DPRD according to the principles of autonomy and co-administration based on the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
16. Regent is the Regent of Morowali.
17. Office of Village Community Empowerment, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as Dinas PMDP3A, is the regional apparatus of Morowali Regency that implements government affairs in the field of women and children.

CHAPTER II
text:
BAB II

BENTUK KEKERASAN
translated_text:
CHAPTER II

FORMS OF VIOLENCE

heading: Article 3
Article 4
text:
Pasal 4

Kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 3 huruf a mengakibatkan: a. korban mendapat rasa sakit atau luka berat;

b. matinya korban; dan

c. menimbulkan penyakit atau halangan untuk menjalankan pekerjaan jabatan atau mata pencaharian atau kegiatan sehari-hari.
translated_text:
Article 4

Physical violence as referred to in Article 3 letter a results in: a. the victim experiencing pain or serious injury;

b. death of the victim; and

c. causing illness or obstruction in carrying out work, position or livelihood or daily activities.

heading: Article 5
Article 6
text:
Pasal 6

dalam Pasal a huruf b

Kekerasan seksual sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 3 huruf c meliputi: a. perbuatan pelecehan seksual;

b. pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan tidak wajar atau tidak disukai; c. pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan orang lain untuk tujuan komersil dan/ atau tujuan tertentu; dan

d. kekerasan seksual melalui media sosial.
translated_text:
Article 6

in Article a letter b

Sexual violence as referred to in Article 3 letter c includes: a. acts of sexual harassment;

b. coercion of unnatural or unwanted sexual relations; c. coercion of sexual relations with others for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes; and

d. sexual violence through social media.

heading: Article 7
CHAPTER III
text:
BAB III

HAK PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK DARI TINDAK KEKERASAN
translated_text:
CHAPTER III

RIGHTS OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

heading: Article 8
Article 9
text:
Pasal 9

(1) Dalam hal korban tindak Kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 membutuhkan penanganan berkelanjutan, maka berhak untuk tinggal di rumah aman atau tempat tinggal alternatif.

(2) Penanganan berkelanjutan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) merupakan penanganan pada tahap rehabilitasi yang dilakukan baik oleh individu, kelompok atau lembaga Pemerintah maupun non-Pemerintah.
translated_text:
Article 9

(1) In the event that victims of acts of Violence as referred to in Article 8 require ongoing treatment, they are entitled to stay in a safe house or alternative residence.

(2) Ongoing treatment as referred to in paragraph (1) constitutes treatment at the rehabilitation stage carried out by individuals, groups or Government and non-Government institutions.

heading: Article 1O
text:
Pasal 1O

(1) Rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 9 ayat (1) memberikan tempat dan/atau penampung€rn €unan sementara bagi korban Kekerasan sampai dengan hak dipulihkan.

(2) Penyelenggaraan dan/atau pengelolaan rumah arnar: sebagaimana dimal<sud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh Dinas PMDP3A.

(3) Untuk keamanan dan atas permintaan korban Kekerasan, pengelola atau pen5relenggara rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) dapat menempatkan korban Kekerasan di tempat tertentu yang dirahasiakan.

{4) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai penyelenggara ruma}r aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) diatur dalam Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 1O

(1) Safe houses as referred to in Article 9 paragraph (1) provide temporary shelter and/or accommodation for victims of Violence until their rights are restored.

(2) The operation and/or management of safe houses as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the PMDP3A Office.

(3) For security and at the request of victims of Violence, the manager or organizer of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (2) may place victims of Violence in certain confidential locations.

{4) Further provisions regarding the organizers of safe houses as referred to in paragraph (2) are regulated in the Regent's Regulation.

heading: Article 1 I
text:
Pasal 1 I

Anak sebagai korban tindak selain mendapatkan hak-hak

Kekerasan sebagaimala dimaksud dalam Pasal 8, juga mendapatkan hak khusus, sebagai berikut:

a. hak penghormatan atas kelangsungan hidup, tumbuh dan berkembang; b. hak pelayanan dasar;
c. hak perlindungan yang sama;
d. hak bebas dari berbagai stigma; dan/atau
e. hak mendapatkal kebebasan.
translated_text:
Article 1 I

Children as victims of acts in addition to receiving the rights

of Violence as referred to in Article 8, also receive special rights, as follows:

a. the right to respect for survival, growth and development; b. the right to basic services;
c. the right to equal protection;
d. the right to be free from various stigma; and/or
e. the right to obtain freedom.

Part One

heading: Article 12
text:
Pasal 12

(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewaj iban:

a. melaksanakan kebijakan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak darl tindak Kekerasan yang ditetapkan pemerintah;
b. menetapkan kebijakan, pro€fam, dan kegiatan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak <iari tinriak kekerasan; dan
c. melakukan kerjasama dengan aparatur penegak hukum, aparatur pemerintah, serta lembaga pendidikan, kesehatan, rumah sakit, dan berbagai Lembaga Swadaya Masyarakat yang peduli terhadap Perempuan dan Anak dalam penyelengg€rraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan.
(2) Pemerintah Daerah bertanggungiawab:
a. memberikan dukungan sarana dan prasarana pelaksanaan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan; dan b. mengalokasikan anggaran penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan sesuai kemampuan keuangan Daerah. (3) Dalam hal pelaksanaan kewajiban Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimala dimalsud pada ayat (1) dan pelaksanaan tanggung -iawab Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat l2\, Pemerintah Daerah men1rusun Rencana Aksi Daerah untuk perlindungan korban. (4) Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) merupakan bagran Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah.
translated_text:
Article 12

(1) The Regional Government has the obligations:

a. to implement policies for the protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence established by the government;
b. to establish policies, programs, and activities for the protection of Women and Children from acts of violence; and
c. to cooperate with law enforcement officials, government officials, as well as educational, health, hospital institutions, and various Non-Governmental Organizations that care for Women and Children in the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence.
(2) The Regional Government is responsible:
a. to provide support for facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence; and b. to allocate budget for the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence according to the Regional financial capacity. (3) In the case of the implementation of Regional Government obligations as referred to in paragraph (1) and the implementation of Regional Government responsibilities as referred to in paragraph l2\, the Regional Government formulates a Regional Action Plan for victim protection. (4) The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (3) constitutes part of the Medium Term Development Plan.

heading: Article 13
text:
Pasal 13

Bupati dalam melaksanakan kewajiban sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 12 mendelegasikal kepada Dinas PMDP3A dan/atau Perangkat Daerah terkait sesuai kewen€mgannya.
translated_text:
Article 13

The Regent in carrying out obligations as referred to in Article 12 delegates to the PMDP3A Office and/or related Regional Apparatus in accordance with their authority.

heading: Part Two
text:
Bagian Kedua

Masyarakat dan Keluarga
translated_text:
Part Two

Community and Family

heading: Article 14
text:
Pasal 14

(1) Masyarakat dan keluarga mempunyai kewajiban dan tanggung jawab sebagai berikut:

a. mencegah terjadinya Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak; b. memberikan informasi dan/ atau melaporkan tindak Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak kepada penegak hukum atau pihak yang berwenang;
c. turut serta dalam pendampingan penang€rnurn korban tindak Kekerasan;
d. melindungi korban; dan
e. memberikan pertolongan darurat.
(2) Bentuk peran serta masyarakat dan keluarga dilaksanakan secara bertanggung jawab sesuai ketentuan peraturan pe r.rndalg-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 14

(1) The community and family have the following obligations and responsibilities:

a. to prevent the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children; b. to provide information and/or report acts of Violence against Women and Children to law enforcement or authorized parties;
c. to participate in the assistance and handling of victims of acts of Violence;
d. to protect victims; and
e. to provide emergency assistance.
(2) Forms of community and family participation are carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of statutory regulations.

heading: Article 17
Article 18
text:
Pasal 18

Pelayanan pengaduan sebagaimana dimaksud da.lam Pasal 17 ayat (l) huruf a meliputi:

a. identifikasi atau pencatatan awal korban; dan
b. persetujuan dilakukan tindakan.

I
translated_text:
Article 18

Complaint services as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (l) letter a include:

a. identification or initial recording of victims; and
b. consent to take action.

I

heading: Article 19
Article 20
text:
Pasal 20

Bantuan hukum sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf c untuk membantu korban dalam menjalani proses peradilan dengan cara: a. memberikan konsultasi hukum yang mencakup informasi mengenai hak korban dan proses peradilan;

b. mendampingi korban di tingkat pelaporan, penyidikan, penuntutan, dan pemeriksaan dalam sidang pengadilan dan membantu korban untuk secara lengkap memaparkan Kekerasal yang dialaminya; dan

c. melakukan koordinasi dengan sesarna penegak hukum, relawan pendamping, dan pekerja sosial agar proses peradilan berjalan sebagaimana mestinya.
translated_text:
Article 20

Legal aid as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (1) letter c to assist victims in undergoing judicial proceedings by: a. providing legal consultation that includes information regarding victims' rights and judicial proceedings;

b. accompanying victims at the level of reporting, investigation, prosecution, and examination in court hearings and helping victims to fully describe the Violence they have experienced; and

c. coordinating with fellow law enforcers, volunteer assistants, and social workers so that judicial proceedings run as they should.

heading: Article 2 1
text:
Pasal 2 1

(1) Pelayanan penyampaian laporan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf d bermaksud mendampingi Perempuan dan Anak sebagai korban tindak kekerasan setelah tidak berhasilnya dilakukan mediasi oleh UPTD PPA dan unit pengaduan Perempuan dan Anak lainnya.

(2) Pelayanan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf d bertujuan untuk mengembalikan korban untuk diterima kembali dalam lingkungan sosialnya.

(3) Pelayanan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial korban tersebut dilakukan setelah terlaksananya sosialisasi terkait hak Perempuan dan Anak sebagai korban kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 2 1

(1) Reporting submission services as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (1) letter d intend to accompany Women and Children as victims of acts of violence after unsuccessful mediation by UPTD PPA and other Women and Children complaint units.

(2) Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (1) letter d aim to return victims to be accepted back into their social environment.

(3) Repatriation and social reintegration services for these victims are carried out after the implementation of socialization regarding the rights of Women and Children as victims of violence.

heading: Article 22
Article 23
text:
Pasal 23

Pelayanan psikologis sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf g merupakan suatu tindakan yang dilakukan untuk memulihkan psikis Perempuan dan Anak sebagai korban tindak kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 23

Psychological services as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (1) letter g constitute an action taken to restore the psyche of Women and Children as victims of acts of violence.

heading: Article 24
Article 25
text:
Pasal 25

(1) Pelayanan perlindungan kepada Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak kekerasan dilalsanal<an secara terpadu oleh UPTD PPA sebagai pusat pelayanan terpadu da-tam perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak sebagai korban tindak kekerasan.

(2) Pelayanan perlindungan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilimpahkan oleh UPTD PPA kepada unit pelayaaan lainnya secara berjejaring dan ke{a bersama.
translated_text:
Article 25

(1) Protection services for Women and Children from acts of violence are carried out in an integrated manner by UPTD PPA as an integrated service center in the protection of Women and Children as victims of acts of violence.

(2) Protection services as referred to in paragraph (1) may be delegated by UPTD PPA to other service units in a networked and collaborative manner.

heading: Article 26
text:
Pasal 26

(f) Dalam upaya menyediakan dan menyelenggarakan pelayanan bagi korban, Pemerintah Daerah membentuk FKPKK.

(2) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pembentukan, tugas, pokok, dan fungsi serta keanggotaan FKPKK sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 26

(f) In an effort to provide and organize services for victims, the Regional Government establishes FKPKK.

(2) Further provisions regarding the establishment, main duties, functions and membership of FKPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 29

(1) In order to achieve the objective of protecting Women's rights from acts of Violence, the Regional Government cooperates with:

a. other Regional Governments; and
b. non-governmental institutions.

(21 Cooperation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. exchange of data and information;

translated_text:
CHAPTER IX

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

heading: Article 3O
text:
Pasal 3O

(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dan tindak Kekerasan.

(2) Pembinaan dan Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: t2

a. koordinasi;

b. bimbingan;

c. pendidikan dan pelatihan; dan

d. pemantauan dan evaluasi.

(3) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (2) dalam rangka mewujudkan tujuan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan sesuai standar pelayanan minimal yang dilaksanakan Dinas PMDPSA dan masyarakat.

(4) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) dilakukan dengan prinsip profesional dan tranparan.

(5) Dinas PMDP3A wajib melaporkan secara berkala kepada Bupati mengenai penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak korban Kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 3O

(1) The Regional Government is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence.

(2) Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) include: t2

a. coordination;

b. guidance;

c. education and training; and

d. monitoring and evaluation.

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) in order to realize the objective of protecting Women and Children from acts of Violence according to minimum service standards implemented by the PMDPSA Office and the community.

(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (3) are carried out with professional and transparent principles.

(5) The PMDP3A Office is required to report periodically to the Regent regarding the implementation of protection of Women and Children victims of Violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Protection from violence that threatens the safety and health of women and children must be provided from an early age. Protection is necessary to prevent violence and physical, mental and sexual exploitation. For example, women and children who are victims of abuse, neglect, expulsion and maltreatment by parents or other persons. For women and children experiencing such problems the government must provide Safe Houses and adequate budget, the role of various parties to help handle violence problems faced by children and women including social community organizations, volunteers, social workers, medical personnel, advocates and religious figures.

The condition of children's deterioration along with their rights and the condition of violence against children and women that frequently occurs in the region should be a common concern for all stakeholders, not least the regional government, to play a role in preventing and addressing such deterioration and violence.

For the regional government of Morowali Regency in facing the universe of conditions above, various actions are taken to fulfill children's rights and to prevent and assist in handling acts of violence against children and women which are endeavored by establishing a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence.
